title: Multiple LLM Agents Debate for Equitable Cultural Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM accuracy on the NORMAD-ETI benchmark, which tests understanding of situational social etiquette norms across 75 countries. Bias is quantified by measuring 'cultural group parity', which compares the mean prediction accuracies across eight distinct cultural regions (defined by the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map) against the best-performing group (English-speaking) to identify disparities in cultural alignment.
